title: Ciena buys AI interconnect startup Nubis for $270M

sources.quote: Under the terms of the agreement, Ciena will acquire Nubis in an all-cash transaction for $270 million, subject to a customary purchase price adjustment mechanism for the amount of cash, debt, and net working capital of Nubis at closing, among other items.
On October 7, 2025, Ciena Corporation completed its acquisition of privately-held Nubis Communications, Inc.

explain: Optical networking company Ciena paid $270 million in cash for Nubis, a New Jersey startup making compact, low-power optical and electrical links that connect AI chips. The deal closed in October 2025.
